privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Valencia Dentistry (“we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with us through SMS/text messaging.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information:

• Full name

• Email address

• Phone number (including mobile number for SMS)

• Mailing address

• Date of birth

• Any other information you provide through contact forms or during appointments

Non-Personal Information:

• Browser type and version

• IP address

• Device type and operating system

• Pages visited and time spent on our website

• Referring website or source

2. Cookie & Tracking Practices

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic.

Types of Cookies We Use:

• Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly (e.g., session management, security).

• Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website (e.g., Google Analytics).

• Functional Cookies: Remember your preferences and settings.

• Marketing Cookies: Used to deliver relevant advertisements and track campaign performance.

Your Cookie Choices:

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when cookies are being sent. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

Third-Party Tracking:

We may use third-party services such as Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel to analyze website traffic and marketing performance. These services may collect information about your online activities across different websites.

3. Data Security and Handling

We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Security Measures Include:

• SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission

• Secure servers with restricted access

• Regular security assessments and updates

• Employee training on data protection

• Access controls limiting data access to authorized personnel only

Data Retention:

We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When data is no longer needed, it will be securely deleted or anonymized.

Please Note: While we strive to protect your personal information, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

4. User Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

• Right to Access: You may request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.

• Right to Correction: You may request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal information.

• Right to Deletion: You may request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain legal exceptions.

• Right to Opt-Out: You may opt-out of receiving marketing communications at any time.

• Right to Data Portability: You may request a copy of your data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

• Right to Restrict Processing: You may request that we limit the processing of your personal information under certain circumstances.

To Exercise Your Rights:

Please contact us at ValenciaDentistryCA@gmail.com or call (661) 254-5200. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

5. Mobile Information Sharing Statement

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

Information sharing to subcontractors in support services, such as customer service, appointment scheduling software, and SMS delivery services, is permitted solely for the purpose of providing our services to you.

All other use case categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent. This information will not be shared with any third parties for their own marketing purposes.

6. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

• To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support

• To schedule and manage your dental appointments

• To send appointment reminders and confirmations via SMS or email

• To provide dental services and follow-up care information

• To process payments and billing

• To improve our website and patient experience

• To send promotional offers (only with your consent)

• To comply with legal obligations

7. Sharing Your Information

We will not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information in the following situations:

• Service Providers: With trusted partners who assist in operating our website, delivering services, or processing payments (e.g., appointment scheduling software, SMS service providers).

• Legal Obligations: When required by law, court order, or government request.

• Protection of Rights: To protect our rights, property, safety, or the rights of others.

8. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third-party sites. Please review their privacy policies before submitting any personal information.

9. Children’s Privacy

Our website and SMS services are not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you believe we have collected information from a minor, please contact us immediately so we can delete such information.

10. California Privacy Rights (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):

• Right to know what personal information is collected, used, shared, or sold

• Right to delete personal information held by businesses

• Right to opt-out of the sale of personal information (we do not sell your personal information)

• Right to non-discrimination for exercising your CCPA rights

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

12. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Valencia Dentistry

Address: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, Santa Clarita, CA 91355

Phone: (661) 254-5200

Email: ValenciaDentistryCA@gmail.com

Website: valenciadentistryca.com

terms-and-services.title: Terms and Services
terms-and-services.html:
Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Valencia Dentistry. By using our website, services, or opting into our SMS/text messaging program, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

1. Age Restriction (18+)

You must be at least 18 years of age to use our services, website, and SMS messaging program. By using our services or opting into our text messaging program, you confirm that you are 18 years of age or older. If you are under 18, you may not use our services or opt into our SMS program without the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian.

2. Description of SMS Use Cases

By opting into our SMS/text messaging program, you consent to receive the following types of messages from Valencia Dentistry:

• Appointment reminders and confirmations

• Appointment rescheduling notifications

• Follow-up care instructions after dental procedures

• Recall and preventive care reminders

• Billing and payment notifications

• Office announcements (closures, schedule changes)

• Promotional offers and special discounts (optional)

• Dental health tips and educational content

Message frequency varies based on your appointment schedule and interaction with our services. You may receive approximately 2-4 messages per month, though this may vary.

3. Opt-Out Instructions

You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Simply text “STOP” to any message you receive from us. Upon sending “STOP,” we will send you a confirmation message confirming your unsubscription. After this confirmation, you will no longer receive SMS messages from Valencia Dentistry. If you wish to rejoin our SMS program, you may sign up again through our website or by contacting our office directly.

4. Customer Support Contact

If you experience any issues with the messaging program or have questions, you can get help by:

• Texting “HELP” to any message you receive from us

• Calling us at: (661) 254-5200

• Emailing us at: ValenciaDentistryCA@gmail.com

• Visiting our office at: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, Santa Clarita, CA 91355

Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST.

5. Message & Data Rate Disclosure

Message and data rates may apply to any messages sent to you from us and to us from you. These charges are determined by your wireless carrier and are not the responsibility of Valencia Dentistry. Message frequency varies based on your appointment schedule and interactions with our practice. For questions about your text plan or data plan, please contact your wireless provider directly.

6. Carrier Liability Disclaimer

Carriers (including but not limited to AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Sprint, and other wireless carriers) are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Message delivery is subject to effective transmission by your wireless carrier and their network coverage. Valencia Dentistry is not responsible for any delays, failures, or errors in message delivery caused by your wireless carrier, network issues, or device compatibility problems.

7. Purpose of Data Collection

The information you provide will be used to respond to your inquiry, schedule appointments, provide requested dental services, send appointment reminders, and improve your patient experience. Your data will not be shared with third parties without your consent, except as required by law or as described in our Privacy Policy.

8. Privacy Policy

For information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Policy at: valenciadentistryca.com/privacy-policy

9. Accuracy of Information

You certify that the information provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge. Misuse or fraudulent submission of any forms or information is prohibited and may result in termination of services and/or legal action.

10. Non-Binding Communication

Submission of contact forms or opting into our SMS program does not constitute a binding agreement or contract for dental services. A formal agreement or consent form will be required for any treatments provided by Valencia Dentistry.

11. Response Time

While we aim to respond to inquiries promptly, response times may vary depending on the volume of requests and office hours.

12. Limitation of Liability

Valencia Dentistry is not liable for any loss, damage, or inconvenience caused by delays, inaccuracies, or failures to respond to inquiries submitted through our website, contact forms, or SMS messaging program.

13. Spam and Abuse

Submissions intended for spam, solicitation, or other misuse of our contact forms or messaging systems will not be tolerated. IP addresses and contact information may be flagged and blocked if misuse is detected.

14. Intellectual Property

Any materials or ideas shared with Valencia Dentistry via our website or messaging systems may not infringe upon the intellectual property rights of any third party. All content on our website is the property of Valencia Dentistry and is protected by applicable copyright laws.

15. Data Security

While we implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, we cannot guarantee complete security. By using our services, you accept the inherent risks of online communication.

16. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time without prior notice. Changes will be posted on this page and will take effect immediately upon publication. Your continued use of our services after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

17. Governing Law

These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of the State of California.
